name: PR Genie
description: Local pull requests for AI agent work — nothing reaches GitHub until you say so. AI coding agents can push half-reviewed code upstream; PR Genie gives that work a local review lane so a human decides what gets published. I built a TypeScript monorepo with a CLI, a Cursor MCP plugin (hooks, rules, slash commands), and a VS Code/Cursor extension with a live watch list of agent loops. Each loop gets its own branch and git worktree with local diffs, comments, and status; an export gate checks CI before anyone pushes.
stack: TypeScript, Node 20+, pnpm, git worktrees, MCP, Cursor plugin, VS Code extension, GitHub Actions

name: swarmDraft
description: Git for the literary world — a desktop manuscript editor where AI bots are named collaborators suggesting tracked changes you accept or reject. Writers juggle versions and silent AI rewrites; swarmDraft keeps every change, human or bot, attributed and reviewable. I am founder, product owner, and lead engineer: I designed the architecture and run an AI-assisted workflow while I review and merge. Novelists first; policies and ToS docs later.
stack: Tauri (Rust, SQLite), Vue 3, TypeScript, Tiptap/ProseMirror, Yjs, .docx import/export, Windows-first, GitHub Actions

name: botVault
description: Drive-backed MCP vault that gives bots shared, attributable project state, with per-bot tokens and version history.

name: flutter_ble_peripheral
description: A Flutter package for advertising BLE data in peripheral mode — useful when a phone or device needs to broadcast rather than only scan. Pairs with my BLE Proximity Detection white paper on this site.

name: go-server
description: A small Go HTTP server starter I keep around as a clean baseline for experiments and services.
